title: Line-art storyboard · the cat question
technique: One 12-panel line-art storyboard sets every shot's order and framing; separate photos give the faces, rooms and props; words add the voices.
story: At night a cat lady sits on her sofa, candles burning all over her apartment, her cat beside her.
She scrolls the Fig & Cedar product page up and down, searching. She does not buy.
Inner voice, lips closed, the camera circling her: “Are these safe for cats?”
She finds nothing, gets annoyed (shown only) and closes the site: “I guess we'll never know.”
High flip down to the owner reading her sales: “I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this. Time to discontinue the product line.” She blows out the candle.
Scout: “Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.” End screen: “Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.”

shots.what: Wide: candle-filled apartment at night; she sits on the sofa with her laptop, the cat curled beside her; slow arc in.
Hard cut, over her shoulder: her fingers scroll the Fig & Cedar page down, then back up. No click.
Hard cut, close-up, camera circles her face; lips closed; cat soft behind.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner voice)

shots.what: Hard cut: she scrolls faster, finds nothing about pets; jaw tight, sharp exhale, rubs her brow. Silent.
Hard cut: she closes the site, leans back, looks at the cat.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner voice)

shots.what: High flip: camera rises over her to straight down, the sofa back sweeps across as the view flips, and it comes out level on the owner at her desk.
Lands from the flip: the owner reads units sold (Fig & Cedar at 3), the lit jar beside her laptop; she sighs.
shots.line: I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this. Time to discontinue the product line.
shots.speaker: Owner (on camera)

shots.what: Hard cut, close-up: she leans in and blows out the Fig & Cedar candle; three flames out, smoke rises.
Hard cut, macro on the smoking wicks; the studio dims.
shots.line: Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.
shots.speaker: Scout (off screen)

shots.what: Hard cut to the H158 end screen.
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout (off screen)
